item.title: Show HN: Health medical messaging with ER7 pipe-hat and Rust
item.summary: I'm working on health medical messaging using Rust to parse the worldwide standard ER7 pipe-hat format. ER7 message parsing Rust crate: https://crates.io/crates/er7 I'm seeking advice about what would help improve the README examples, to make it easier or better to use in your own HL7 health care projects. Source is https://github.com/er7-rust/er7-rust Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49318858 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
